sources.basis: Official metadata describes public free speed feeds; DOT page requires attribution/disclaimer and links Open Data terms. Full redistribution conditions and current raw-unit semantics not fully verified.
sources.version: metadata last modified 2010-07-20; no raw file
sources.reason: Speed/travel time metadata does not define this project's congestion index; missing congestion cannot be invented or filled with zero.

admission_states.verified_authorized: External applicable licence reviewed with evidence and scope; no currently imported third-party dataset has this status.
admission_states.unverified: Not eligible for import, including partial licence reviews.
admission_states.synthetic_test: Original generated test data; never a claim of real traffic collection.
